sources.snippet: SmolVLA SmolVLA is Hugging Face’s lightweight foundation model for robotics. Designed for easy fine-tuning on LeRobot datasets, it helps accelerate your development! Figure 1. SmolVLA takes as input (i) multiple cameras views, (ii) the robot’s current sensorimotor state, and (iii) a natural language instruction, encoded into contextual features used to condition the action expert when ...
